channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Tetris® Forever
item.description: Celebrate 40 years of Tetris® with 15+ games, a new game, and documentary videos

item.title: Wizardry: Proving Grounds of the Mad Overlord
item.description: Wizardry: Proving Grounds of the Mad Overlord is a full 3D remake of the first game in the legendary Wizardry series of RPGs.

item.title: Age of Empires II: DE - Chronicles: Battle for Greece
item.description: Chronicles features Age of Empires II gameplay set in antiquity. In Battle for Greece, the first chapter of this multi-part saga, fight with three new ancient civilizations and experience a grand narrative campaign, from the Ionian Revolt to the Peloponnesian War.

item.title: Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition (Base Game)
item.description: Unlock the full game experience of Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition. *Note: This DLC unlock is automatically given to people who have previously bought the full base game.

item.title: Dispatch
item.description: Dispatch is a superhero workplace comedy where choices matter. Manage a dysfunctional team of misfit heroes and strategize who to send to emergencies around the city, all while balancing office politics, personal relationships, and your own quest to become a hero. All episodes out now!

item.title: Gladiator Guild Manager
item.description: A strategic autobattler sim where you build a team of gladiators, compete in arenas, plan fight tactics, and form alliances. Combine fighters, beasts, and mages, develop and equip them to optimize your well-oiled fighting machine, dominate the championships, and leave your mark on the world.

item.title: Holdfast: Nations At War
item.description: Fight on multiple fronts in Holdfast: Nations At War - A multiplayer first and third-person shooter set during the great Napoleonic Era and WW1. Charge into battle with over 150 players per server!

item.title: Momento
item.description: Momento is a cozy room decorator with a twist: the choices you make play out over the course of a lifetime! Decorate your room, choose which items are important to you, and discover how the objects you choose will alter the course of the story, in a winding ode to the power of everyday things.

item.title: Paleo Pines
item.description: Welcome to Paleo Pines, a charming island known for its friendly dinosaurs, quirky townsfolk, and mysterious past. Befriend dinos and enlist their help to fix up your ranch and farm crops to create your cozy dino sanctuary! Then set out with your companion, Lucky, to uncover the island’s secrets.

item.title: shapez 2 - Factory
item.description: Dive into a factory-building game with the focus on just that – building huge space factories! Design sprawling multi-level factories and satisfying production lines without limits. Tackle progressively challenging automation goals at your own pace, without the threat of enemies.

item.title: Titanium Court
item.description: A surreal strategy game for clowns and criminals.

item.title: Vellum
item.description: Write on! Defend the books in Vellum, a co-op, literary roguelike! Harness class-defining colors, master an inspired spellbook, and influence the growth of your enemy! As a group or solo, you'll craft plot-twisting builds to rewrite the rules in Ink!

item.title: Guild Wars® Bonus Mission Pack
item.description: Step into Tyriaʼs past as its greatest heroes, experience their defining moments, and claim exclusive rewards in the Bonus Mission Pack.

item.title: Gravity Circuit
item.description: Gravity Circuit is a flashy action packed 2D platformer in the spirit of console classics. Follow Kai, a lone operative war hero who harnesses the mysterious powers of the Gravity Circuit, on an adventure in a futuristic world inhabited by sentient robots.
